items.title: This Is Wonderland (S. 1 Ep. 1) – Drama
items.description:
There's not much "order" in the law-and-order series This is Wonderland. Alice (Cara Pifko), a junior lawyer, tumbles into the chaotic world of big-city courts filled with too many cases, not enough lawyers and judges, and a cast of offbeat and desperate characters.
